name: Nocturne Lanternwing
descriptionSv: En liten ugglefjäril med ansiktskrans, klor och fyra fjärilsvingar kantade av fjädrar.
promptEn: Fuse a compact owl chest and silver facial disk with feathery moth antennae and four rounded violet membrane wings. Midnight feathers grow along each wing margin, silver crescents sit within the membranes, and two sturdy owl talons support a soft segmented abdomen.

name: Prismwing Skitter
descriptionSv: En kristallgecko med stora tådynor, böjd svans och fyra mjuka nattfjärilsvingar.
promptEn: Create a low turquoise gecko with splayed lavender adhesive toes and a curled crystalline tail. Four dusk-violet moth wings grow from a soft furry shoulder thorax, their membranes interrupted by tiny crystal veins. Feathery antennae frame an angular lizard brow above focused eyes.

name: Tempest Silkmane
descriptionSv: En kraftig lodjursfjäril med tofsöron, antenner och fyra blixtådrade vingar.
promptEn: Combine powerful lynx haunches, oversized feline forepaws and black ear tufts with a plush moth thorax ruff. Four angular violet membrane wings emerge behind the shoulders, crossed by pale cyan branching veins. Long whiskers curve upward into paired feathery antennae; the tail stays short and feline.

name: Briar Velvetmaw
descriptionSv: En grävling med randigt ansikte, taggig rygg och veckade nattfjärilsvingar.
promptEn: Build a squat digging beast with a badger striped muzzle and broad shovel claws. Four thick moth wings fold like serrated leaves along its back, anchored between emerald thorn ridges. Lavender thorax fur blends into charcoal badger flanks, while brushlike antennae sweep back from small rounded ears.

name: Ashsilk Nightfang
descriptionSv: En varglik nattfjäril med glödande nackpäls och långa sotfärgade vingar.
promptEn: Make a lean wolf with a long fanged muzzle, springy canine legs and a full brush tail. Its red ember neck mane becomes moth thorax fluff, supporting four narrow smoke-violet wings with copper veins. Feathered antennae rise beside pointed ears, and wing tips curl like singed velvet.

name: Rimewing Clamber
descriptionSv: En bergsget med ishorn och frostiga fjärilsvingar som växer ur ullen.
promptEn: Combine an ibex barrel chest, cloven hooves and two sweeping ice horns with a moth abdomen tapering into a short fuzzy tail. Four broad violet wings emerge through white shoulder wool, crystal frost tracing their scalloped edges. Fine antennae curve between the horns above a determined goat face.

name: Gilded Nightpride
descriptionSv: Ett lejon med fjärilsmjuk man, antenner och fyra solkantade nattvingar.
promptEn: Create a muscular lion whose circular mane is layered moth fluff and golden fur. Four broad violet membrane wings emerge from the shoulder girdle, their margins fringed with sun-gold hairs. Keep a feline muzzle, broad paws, tufted lion tail and paired plume antennae rising through the mane.

name: Runesilk Hart
descriptionSv: En hjortfjäril med greniga horn, klövar och runådrade vingar.
promptEn: Give a compact stag four fine cloven legs, a long deer muzzle and branching wooden antlers. Four dusk-moth wings unfold from its narrow torso, mint rune veins following the membranes. Its cream chest becomes lavender thorax fur, and feather antennae grow beside the antler bases rather than replacing them.

name: Reefsilk Wyrmling
descriptionSv: En koralldrake med antenner och fyra fjärilsvingar mellan koralltaggarna.
promptEn: Merge a coral drake snout, four clawed legs and curled scaled tail with a soft moth thorax. Replace dragon wing membranes with four scalloped violet moth wings supported by coral finger bones. Sea-green fin ears frame feathery antennae; coral spines continue along the upper back.

name: Daybreak Moonflutter
descriptionSv: En fågelfjäril med rovfågelsnäbb, klor och fyra fjäderkantade vingar.
promptEn: Design a regal bird-moth with a phoenix hooked beak and two strong avian feet below a fluffy lilac thorax. Four expansive moth wings have golden feathered leading edges and violet crescent membranes. A short segmented abdomen extends into layered sunrise tail plumes, with two delicate antennae above the crest.

name: Blackglass Silkback
descriptionSv: En tung björn med stenspalter över ryggen och fyra sotlila fjärilsvingar.
promptEn: Create a massive bear with heavy shoulders, round ears and planted clawed paws. Four thick moth wings rise from gaps between natural obsidian shoulder plates; violet velvet membranes carry silver crescents. Soft thorax fur forms its chest, and broad feathery antennae emerge above a stern bear brow.

name: Aurorasilk Courser
descriptionSv: En kirin med klövar, pärlhorn och skimrande fjärilsvingar som möter manen.
promptEn: Fuse a cream kirin body, neat cloven hooves and pearly forehead horn with four rounded moth wings. Their lilac membranes grow from scaled shoulders and flow into mint-pink mane filaments. Feathery antennae sweep back beside deer ears, while a furry segmented tail finishes in silky aurora strands.

name: Veilwing Prowler
descriptionSv: En smygande blå panter med genomskinliga nattvingar och antenner kring öronen.
promptEn: Make a sleek sapphire panther crouching on four broad feline paws, with a long curved tail. Four translucent moth wings grow directly from its shoulder muscles, edged in fuzzy midnight hairs with silver crescents. Paired feather antennae arc behind cat ears; pale cyan currents follow wing veins into the flanks.

name: Moonveil Silkserpent
descriptionSv: En svävande andedrake med böjd kropp, pälsig bröstkrans och fyra nattfjärilsvingar.
promptEn: Build a compact floating S-shaped serpent with a horned dragon head and complete tapered tail. A moth thorax ruff surrounds its upper neck, supporting four large violet membrane wings. Feathered antennae extend beside silver horns, while sapphire belly scales gradually become soft lilac segments toward the wing roots.

name: Acorn Bastionhog
descriptionSv: En låg vildsvinspadda med betar, klövar och en välvd sköldpaddssköld.
promptEn: Combine a round terrapin shell and heavy low turtle shoulders with a boar snout, short ivory tusks and four stout cloven feet. Brown striped bristles grow between warm terracotta shell panels, while jade scaled cheeks meet a blunt pig muzzle. A short curled tail emerges below the shell rim.

name: Cinder Shellpride
descriptionSv: Ett lejon med glödande man kring halsen och en sköld som växer ur ryggen.
promptEn: Create a compact lion with broad padded paws and a rounded terrapin shell integrated into its back. Ember mane tufts frame the shell opening around the neck, exposing jade scales beneath orange cheek fur. The tail is thick at its turtle base and ends in a fiery lion tuft.

name: Mooncarapace Watcher
descriptionSv: En uggla med rund ryggsköld, fjälliga klor och silverfjädrar längs skalet.
promptEn: Make a stout upright owl with a silver facial disk, hooked beak and two strong scaled talons. A terracotta turtle shell forms the rounded back, with folded midnight wings emerging from its side openings. Jade scales cover the lower neck; small feathers trace the shell seams and crescent-shaped rim.

name: Prismplate Snapper
descriptionSv: En sköldpaddsgecko med klättertår, lång svans och kristalliserade skalplattor.
promptEn: Fuse a low turtle shell and broad reptile head with a gecko flexible spine, splayed adhesive toes and long curled tail. Terracotta scutes become raised turquoise crystal facets toward the spine, leaving the protective rim clearly visible. Lavender toe pads and narrow focused eyes emphasize the agile gecko anatomy.

name: Thunderplate Stalker
descriptionSv: Ett lodjur med skyddande ryggsköld, stora tassar och blixtar längs skalets fogar.
promptEn: Design a crouched lynx with tall tufted ears, broad cat paws and compact hindquarters. A high terrapin shell grows over its back, split into warm ochre plates by cyan lightning seams. Jade scales armor the ankles beneath grey fur, and a short bobtail protrudes through the rear shell opening.

name: Briarback Rampart
descriptionSv: En grävling med grävklor, randigt ansikte och en taggig sköldpaddsrygg.
promptEn: Give a low badger body a broad domed turtle shell edged with emerald thorn growths. Its cream-and-charcoal striped muzzle extends from a jade scaled neck, and heavy digging foreclaws support the shell. Rough grey fur emerges between the shell rim and muscular hind legs; a short badger tail remains visible.

name: Furnace Shellfang
descriptionSv: En varg med sotig päls, tänder och en tung glödande ryggsköld.
promptEn: Combine a wolf long muzzle, pointed ears and powerful canine legs with a terrapin carapace fitted to its hunched back. Orange mane fur spills around the shell front; ochre plates bear thin ember seams. Jade ankle scales transition to charcoal paws, and a full wolf brush tail exits the shell.

name: Glacier Carapace
descriptionSv: En bergsget med ishorn och en sköld vars kant liknar packis.
promptEn: Create a sturdy ibex with swept ice horns, a short beard and four cloven hooves. Its barrel torso is enclosed in a turtle shell, terracotta panels frosted into blue facets along the rim. White wool protrudes naturally from neck and leg openings, with jade scales on its lower muzzle.

name: Solstice Shieldlion
descriptionSv: Ett tungt lejon med solman, breda tassar och en hög ryggsköld.
promptEn: Fuse a large golden lion chest and round mane with a terrapin domed back and plated underbelly. The mane frames the shell neck opening in short thick rays. Broad clawed paws have jade scaled wrists; ochre shell scutes echo the mane layering, and a full tufted tail curls around the rear.

name: Runebark Shellhart
descriptionSv: En hornprydd hjort med klövar och ett skal som möter barkliknande ryggplattor.
promptEn: Give a stag branching antlers, fine cloven legs and a cream throat beneath a turtle shell. The high carapace is warm brown with mint rune grooves, merging into barklike scutes around the shoulders. Jade scales appear on the long deer muzzle and knees, while the short deer tail emerges below the rim.

name: Coral Citadelle
descriptionSv: En fyrbent revdrake med sköld, korallvingar och kraftig böjd svans.
promptEn: Make a squat reef dragon with coral horns, sea-green cheek fins and four powerful clawed legs. A terrapin shell replaces the upper back, with coral branches growing from its scute seams. Small membranous dragon wings attach beside the shell rim, and the long scaled tail curls outside the protective silhouette.

name: Sunvault Firecrest
descriptionSv: En fågel med sköldpaddsrygg, gyllene vingar och två kraftiga klor.
promptEn: Build an upright phoenix with hooked golden beak, avian talons and broad sunrise wings. A rounded turtle carapace covers its back, with feathers growing from the side openings and warm shell seams. Jade scales form the lower throat and feet; layered flame-tail plumes extend completely beyond the shell rim.

name: Blackvault Ursadon
descriptionSv: En massiv björn med bred sköldpaddsrygg och stenhårda skulderplattor.
promptEn: Combine a bear enormous forequarters, broad muzzle and four planted clawed paws with a high terrapin shell. Obsidian armor plates replace the upper scutes, transitioning to warm ochre panels at the rim. Jade scales cover the neck below dense charcoal fur; retain small round bear ears and a short heavy tail.

name: Pearlshell Kirin
descriptionSv: En lätt kirin med pärlhorn, klövar och skimrande fjäll kring ryggskölden.
promptEn: Create a compact kirin with a pearly forehead horn, flowing pastel mane and four delicate hooves. Its back carries a naturally grown turtle carapace, with terracotta panels merging into lilac scales around the neck. The mane threads between shell ridges, while its long silky tail extends freely from the rear opening.

name: Veilvault Prowler
descriptionSv: En blå panter med sköldpaddsrygg och ljus som löper genom skalets fogar.
promptEn: Make a low stalking panther with narrow feline face, large paws and a curved muscular tail. A terrapin shell arches over its back, its strong rounded scutes translucent sapphire at the edges. Jade scales blend into spectral blue fur along the wrists; cyan currents follow the shell seams into the legs.

name: Astral Coilback
descriptionSv: En slingrande draksköldpadda med kraftigt skal, böjd hals och lång andesvans.
promptEn: Fuse a broad terrapin shell and four sturdy turtle feet with an elongated horned dragon neck and serpentine tail. Sapphire scales flow out of the warm plated carapace, curling into a compact S silhouette behind it. Silver horns, cyan throat fins and a pale segmented belly reveal the spectral wyrm inheritance.

name: Cinder Tuskcub
descriptionSv: Ett knubbigt lejonvildsvin med betar, glödman och kraftiga framtassar.
promptEn: Create a stocky lion cub with a blunt boar snout, ivory side tusks and powerful front paws. Short cloven rear feet brace beneath striped brown haunches. Its ember mane grows from a boar bristle ridge, and a curled pig tail ends in a warm red lion tuft.

name: Moonroot Tuskowl
descriptionSv: En kompakt ugglesvinhybrid med betar, fjädrar och starka grävklor.
promptEn: Merge a round boar barrel body with a broad owl chest and folded midnight feather wings. A silver facial disk frames a short piglike muzzle carrying a small hooked upper beak and ivory tusks. Two heavy front digging talons and stout rear cloven feet support striped bristled flanks.

name: Prismroot Grunter
descriptionSv: Ett fjälligt vildsvin med betar, stora klättertår och kristallsvans.
promptEn: Make a low broad beast with a boar snout, ivory tusks and stout striped torso. Replace hooves with four splayed gecko feet bearing lavender adhesive pads; a long curled lizard tail balances the body. Turquoise crystal ridges grow through its brown bristle spine, continuing onto scaled cheeks and tail.

name: Thunderroot Razorback
descriptionSv: Ett kraftigt lodjurssvin med betar, tofsöron och elektrisk borstkam.
promptEn: Combine a lynx high muscular forelegs and broad feline paws with a boar barrel torso and blunt tusked muzzle. Tall black ear tufts rise above a cyan-streaked bristle ridge. Brown piglet stripes fragment into storm markings, and heavy cloven rear toes and a short curled bobtail complete the mixed anatomy.

name: Briartusk Burrower
descriptionSv: Ett lågt vildsvin med grävlingens ansiktsrand, grävklor och taggig rygg.
promptEn: Fuse a stout boar body, short tusks and flattened rooting snout with a badger striped face and powerful digging foreclaws. Emerald thorns grow through the brown dorsal bristle ridge. Broad hind feet end in split blunt claws resembling hooves; small rounded ears and a short bristly tail reinforce the burrowing silhouette.

name: Embertusk Ravager
descriptionSv: En vargsvinshybrid med lång käke, utstående betar och glödande borstman.
promptEn: Create a forward-leaning predator with a long wolf jaw widened into a boar rooting nose and two upward ivory tusks. Powerful canine forepaws contrast with stocky boar hindquarters and cloven rear feet. Charcoal fur carries a raised red bristle mane, while the full brush tail curls slightly at its tip.

name: Rimehorn Tuskram
descriptionSv: Ett vildsvin med ishorn, betar och tät vit bergsgetsull.
promptEn: Combine a broad boar snout and ivory tusks with a compact ibex chest, split hooves and two long swept ice horns. Dense white goat wool grows around dark striped piglet flanks; icy bristles continue down the back. A small beard under the tusked jaw balances a short curled tail.

name: Goldtusk Pridebreaker
descriptionSv: Ett tungt lejon med vildsvinsnos, betar och en man av gyllene borst.
promptEn: Build a muscular golden lion with a broad boar nose and ivory tusks growing beside its feline fangs. Its circular mane becomes layered golden bristles, continuing into a raised razorback ridge. Large front paws and stout cloven rear feet carry a barrel torso, ending in a curled tufted tail.

name: Runetusk Wildhart
descriptionSv: En hjortsvinshybrid med greniga horn, betar och runor mellan borststråna.
promptEn: Give a sturdy boar chest four longer stag legs and dark cloven hooves. A deer brow with branching wooden antlers slopes into a short tusked rooting muzzle. Chestnut bristles carry mint rune channels, and a cream deer throat tuft joins the bristled chest; keep a short curled boar tail.

name: Reeftusk Broodling
descriptionSv: En koralldrake med betar, vildsvinsnos och korta kraftiga ben.
promptEn: Make a stocky coral drake with a flattened boar snout, broad ivory tusks and a bristled cheek ruff. Four short clawed legs support its barrel torso; coral wings and sea-green fins grow from the shoulders. A long curled scaled tail retains a tiny bristle tuft, with piglet stripes visible between coral plates.

name: Sunbristle Firehog
descriptionSv: Ett vildsvin med gyllene fjädervingar, betar och en flammande stjärtplym.
promptEn: Fuse a boar sturdy barrel chest and tusked rooting muzzle with a phoenix sharp hooked upper beak and broad golden wings. Brown bristles transition into orange feather quills along its spine. Four stout legs end in hooked hooflike claws, and a compact fan of flame feathers replaces the curled tail.

name: Blacktusk Mauler
descriptionSv: En enorm björnsvinshybrid med betar, framtassar och sprucken vulkanrygg.
promptEn: Create a heavy bear with towering shoulders and enormous clawed forepaws, a boar barrel belly and stout cloven hind feet. Its broad muzzle ends in a rooting nose flanked by ivory tusks. Charcoal fur and brown bristles grow between natural obsidian back plates, with a short curled bristle tail.

name: Opaltusk Courser
descriptionSv: En kirin med pärlhorn, vildsvinsbetar och skimrande borst längs ryggen.
promptEn: Combine a kirin arched neck, pearly horn and four graceful cloven hooves with a compact boar torso and blunt tusked muzzle. Lilac scales emerge through brown striped bristles, while a pastel flowing mane follows the spine. A short curled boar tail extends into mint-pink silky strands.

name: Veiltusk Pouncer
descriptionSv: En blå panter med vildsvinets breda nos, betar och kraftiga bakkropp.
promptEn: Design a crouched spectral panther with wide feline paws and a long curved tail, but a boar powerful barrel hindbody and flattened tusked muzzle. Sapphire bristles form a raised shoulder ridge, pale cyan stripes crossing its translucent flanks. Rounded pig ears blend into pointed feline rims above fierce narrow eyes.

name: Astral Tuskcoil
descriptionSv: En betförsedd andedrake med vildsvinsbogar och lång slingrande svans.
promptEn: Fuse a heavy boar shoulder barrel and four short split-hoof feet with an elongated serpentine dragon neck and full curling tail. The horned head has a broad rooting nose and ivory side tusks. Brown bristles along the shoulder spine transition smoothly into translucent sapphire scales and pale cyan fins.

name: Crescent Cindergriff
descriptionSv: En lejonunge med ugglevingar, ansiktskrans och glödande fjäderman.
promptEn: Fuse a lion cub torso and padded hind paws with feathered owl forelimbs ending in curved talons. A silver owl facial disk surrounds a short feline muzzle and hooked beak tip. Midnight wings emerge behind an ember feather mane, while a tufted lion tail stays fully visible.

name: Cinderprism Cub
descriptionSv: En kristallfjällig lejonunge med klättertår och en lång glödspetsad svans.
promptEn: Give a fiery lion cub a longer gecko torso and curled scaled tail, keeping its rounded feline cheeks and small ember mane. Four broad feet separate into lavender adhesive toes beneath furry ankles. Turquoise crystal spines grow through orange shoulder fur and continue into the tail flame tuft.

name: Sparkmane Lynxcub
descriptionSv: Ett smidigt lodjurslejon med tofsöron, stor man och kraftiga baktassar.
promptEn: Combine a young lion broad chest and small red mane with a lynx long springing hindlegs, large snowshoe paws and tall black ear tufts. A short bobtail sprouts a compact ember plume. Grey flank fur carries fine cyan streaks that branch into the warm mane roots.

name: Briarcinder Scrapper
descriptionSv: En låg lejonunge med grävklor, randigt ansikte och taggar genom glödmanen.
promptEn: Create a low burrowing lion cub with a badger long striped muzzle and powerful digging foreclaws. Its small ember mane blends into a dense emerald thorn collar around the shoulders. Grey stocky hindquarters contrast with orange feline chest fur, and the short badger tail ends in a tiny ember tuft.

name: Coalheart Fangcub
descriptionSv: En bredaxlad lejonvarg med spetsöron och en dubbel glödman.
promptEn: Merge a lion cub round chest, padded forepaws and cheek mane with a wolf long fanged muzzle, tall pointed ears and springy hindlegs. Two distinct mane layers form a compact circular lion ruff and a swept canine dorsal crest. The long brush tail ends in a dense ember tuft.

name: Rimecinder Horncub
descriptionSv: En lejonunge med ishorn, klövade bakfötter och frost i glödmanen.
promptEn: Build a sturdy young lion with two swept crystalline ibex horns growing above rounded feline ears. Padded front paws and cloven back hooves support a compact goatlike barrel. White wool forms the lower beard, while orange ember mane strands curve around icy horn bases; a small tufted tail remains clear.

name: Twincrest Solarpride
descriptionSv: Ett kraftigt lejon med en inre glödman och en yttre solfjäderformad man.
promptEn: Create a compact powerful lion with oversized cub paws, short sturdy limbs and mature Sunmane jaw muscles. Its mane has two anatomically distinct layers: a tight inner ember ruff and broad outer golden cheek fins sweeping backward like rays. The lion tail has a forked double tuft echoing both mane layers.

name: Cinderbranch Hartcub
descriptionSv: En lejonunge med hjorthorn, klövade bakben och runor under glödmanen.
promptEn: Combine a lion cub chest, small ember mane and rounded feline muzzle with a stag branching antlers and long cloven hindlegs. Broad padded forepaws remain lionlike. Mint rune channels trace the chestnut flanks between short orange fur, while the elongated neck and cream throat transition naturally into the mane.

name: Cinderreef Whelp
descriptionSv: En lejonunge med korallvingar, fjällsvans och små horn genom manen.
promptEn: Make a compact feline dragon with broad lion cub paws, an orange ember mane and a short fanged muzzle. Coral horns grow through the mane and small teal membrane wings attach at the shoulders. Coral scales blend into furry hips, continuing along a fully curled dragon tail tipped with ember fur.

name: Dawncrest Liongriff
descriptionSv: En lejonfågel med flammande vingar, klor och en fjäderman kring ansiktet.
promptEn: Fuse a lion cub broad torso and feline hindpaws with a phoenix feathered forechest, hooked front talons and two golden wings. Its short cat muzzle has a small beaked upper tip, framed by a compact ember feather mane. The lion tail opens into a curved three-plume sunrise fan.

name: Emberstone Bruiser
descriptionSv: En björnlik lejonunge med stora tassar och svarta stenplattor runt glödmanen.
promptEn: Give a stout lion cub enormous bear shoulders, round bear ears and heavy planted forepaws. Its small orange mane emerges between obsidian plates around the neck and upper back. A shortened broad bear muzzle retains feline cheek pads, while the stocky rear body carries a thick ember-tipped lion tail.

name: Opalflare Fawncub
descriptionSv: En hornprydd lejonunge med kirinens hals, klövar och pastellfärgad man.
promptEn: Combine a lion cub padded forepaws and compact ember cheek ruff with an arched kirin neck, pearly forehead horn and cloven rear hooves. Lilac scales run through orange shoulder fur. Flowing mint-pink mane strands braid visually with fiery red tufts, and a long silky tail retains a small lion tuft.

name: Veilcinder Stalker
descriptionSv: En blå panter med lejonungens kraftiga tassar och en låg glödande man.
promptEn: Create a low feline hunter with Spectral Panther long spine, curved tail and narrow eyes, enlarged by lion cub forepaws and a compact circular mane. The mane grows into a raised ember dorsal fin of fur. Orange chest hairs transition into translucent sapphire flanks, preserving a single strong muscular silhouette.

name: Astral Manecoil
descriptionSv: En andedrake med lejonungens bogar, framtassar och liten eldig man.
promptEn: Fuse a lion cub stout chest and four padded paws with a long spectral dragon neck and curling scaled tail. The horned dragon face retains broad feline cheek pads, surrounded by an ember mane. Orange fur transitions into sapphire scales along the neck, with pale cyan fins emerging between mane tufts.

name: Prismmoon Climber
descriptionSv: En ugglegecko med ansiktskrans, fjädervingar och stora lila klättertår.
promptEn: Create a low gecko with a curved crystal tail, silver owl facial disk and small hooked beak. Folded midnight feather wings grow from its shoulders above four splayed adhesive feet. Turquoise scales alternate with soft chest feathers, and crescent crystal plates rise along its back beneath focused golden eyes.

name: Thunderdisc Prowler
descriptionSv: Ett lodjur med ugglans ansiktskrans, vingar och fjäderklädda framtassar.
promptEn: Combine a lynx muscular quadruped body, broad hindpaws and short bobtail with an owl silver facial disk and hooked beak tip. Midnight wings attach behind tufted shoulders, while front paws grow curved avian claws. Tall black ear tufts merge with feather crests, crossed by fine cyan lightning veins.

name: Briarmoon Digger
descriptionSv: En grävling med ugglekrans, klor och fjädervingar under ryggtaggarna.
promptEn: Make a squat badger with a long striped muzzle framed by an owl circular silver face ruff. Folded feather wings sit beneath emerald thorn shoulder ridges. Heavy forefeet combine badger digging claws and owl talons, while charcoal hindquarters and a short tail support a dense midnight feathered chest.

name: Ashmoon Howler
descriptionSv: En varg med ugglevingars fjädrar, silverkrans och en flammande nackkam.
promptEn: Fuse a wolf long muzzle, canine legs and full brush tail with an owl broad facial disk and strong feathered wings. Silver face feathers wrap the muzzle without replacing its fangs. Midnight flight feathers grow through ember shoulder fur, and black ear points curve into an alert owl crest.

name: Frostmoon Hornwing
descriptionSv: En bergsget med ugglevingar, ansiktskrans och två stora ishorn.
promptEn: Create an ibex with four cloven hooves and tall swept ice horns above a silver owl facial disk. A short hooked beak tip joins its goat muzzle and beard. Midnight wings grow from its woolly shoulders, with white feather down blending into blue-frosted flank wool and a compact fanned tail.

name: Mooncrown Gryphlion
descriptionSv: Ett lejon med bred ugglekrans, gyllene fjäderman och stora nattvingar.
promptEn: Build a proud lion with broad padded hindpaws and taloned feathered forefeet. A silver owl facial disk sits within a full golden lion mane, surrounding one short feline-beaked muzzle. Large midnight wings rise behind the mane; the tufted lion tail fans into silver-tipped feathers at its end.

name: Runemoon Antlerwing
descriptionSv: En hjort med ugglevingars silhuett, ansiktskrans och greniga horn.
promptEn: Combine a compact stag body, cloven hooves and branching wooden antlers with an owl silver face disk and feathered neck. Two broad midnight wings emerge below the antler line. Mint rune marks continue from brown deer flanks onto the flight feathers, while a short deer muzzle retains a subtle hooked beak tip.

name: Reefmoon Screecher
descriptionSv: En uggledrake med korallhorn, fjädervingar och lång fjällsvans.
promptEn: Make a squat coral dragon with four clawed feet, curled tail and a silver owl facial disk around its beaked fanged muzzle. Broad midnight feather wings retain coral leading-edge bones. Sea-green cheek fins merge into owl ear crests, and coral scales break into pale feathers along the chest.

name: Eclipse Plumecrown
descriptionSv: En kraftig rovfågel med ugglekrans, fenixkrona och dubbla sol- och månvingar.
promptEn: Create one regal two-legged bird combining an owl rounded chest and silver facial disk with a phoenix tall crest, hooked beak and flowing tail plumes. Its two wings layer broad midnight owl flight feathers beneath elongated golden phoenix feathers. A crescent forehead marking sits below a swept sunrise crown.

name: Blackmoon Ursagriff
descriptionSv: En tung ugglebjörn med ansiktskrans, väldiga tassar och stenpansrade vingar.
promptEn: Fuse a bear towering shoulders and heavy four-pawed stance with an owl silver facial disk and short hooked muzzle. Broad midnight wings fold over natural obsidian back plates, their feather roots emerging between stone seams. Bear ears become small feather crests; massive foreclaws curve like thick owl talons.

name: Auroramoon Skyhart
descriptionSv: En kirin med ugglekrans, pärlhorn och breda fjädervingar.

name: Astral Moonseraph

name: Prismstorm Pouncer
descriptionSv: Ett lodjur med klättertår, kristallsvans och elektriska ryggkammar.
promptEn: Fuse a lynx muscular chest, tufted ears and high hindquarters with a gecko flexible elongated back and curled crystal tail. Oversized feline paws spread into lavender adhesive toes. Turquoise crystals protrude through storm-grey shoulder fur, their angular ridges continuing down the spine with fine cyan lightning seams.

name: Prismbriar Burrowback
descriptionSv: En grävlingecko med klättertår och en blandning av kristaller och ryggtaggar.
promptEn: Create a squat badger with a long cream-and-charcoal striped muzzle and broad digging forearms. Gecko adhesive toe pads widen beneath its claws, and a curved scaled tail replaces the short tail. Emerald thorns interlock with turquoise crystal plates along the back, while grey fur merges into scaled flanks.

name: Cinderprism Fangrunner
descriptionSv: En kristallvarg med geckotår, lång fjällsvans och en flammande kristallman.

Turquoise crystals pierce the ember mane and dorsal crest, transitioning from charcoal fur to teal scales toward the hips.

name: Prismhorn Cliffstep

name: Prismmane Sunclaw

Scales spread from the cheekbones onto the flanks, preserving lion muzzle muscles and heavy forequarters.

name: Veilreef Prowldrake
descriptionSv: En panterdrake med korallhorn, vingar och en genomskinlig fjällsvans.
promptEn: Give a stalking spectral panther broad paws, low muscular torso and narrow cat eyes a coral drake scaled muzzle, coral horns and small teal membrane wings. Its long feline tail becomes scaled and finned toward the tip. Coral plates blend into translucent sapphire fur across the shoulders and hips.

name: Astral Reefcoil

promptEn: Create a compact long-necked dragon combining coral drake four clawed limbs and teal membrane wings with a spectral wyrm elongated S-shaped torso and curling tail. Coral head horns flow into small silver tips. Solid coral shoulder scales gradually become translucent sapphire plates toward the pale segmented belly and finned tail.

Two broad sunrise wings grow from gaps in natural obsidian shoulder plates. A short hooked beak ridge joins the powerful bear muzzle, and flame feather plumes replace its tiny tail.

promptEn: Combine a kirin arched neck, pearly horn and four neat cloven hooves with broad phoenix feather wings and a curved flame-plume tail. A subtle hooked beak ridge joins the deerlike muzzle. Lilac scales transition into golden shoulder feathers, while mint-pink mane strands flow through an upright sunrise crest.

name: Astral Dawnswirl

Natural obsidian plates break into translucent sapphire armor scales along the flanks. Charcoal cheek fur remains solid around narrow cyan feline eyes.

Its pastel mane flows between feline ears and down the back, joining a long curved cat tail ending in silky aurora strands.

Sapphire fur becomes translucent scales along the spine and full coiled tail, with cyan fins and silver horns defining the hybrid silhouette.
